scope: Read-only model JSON sources, work.scene wrappers, expected fixtures and converter examples. No schema validation or migration was performed by this inventory. Classification reflects source location and naming, not validation success.
policy: Nonconforming fields retain every exact JSON Pointer, value, lower_step and upper_step in migration_candidates. Shared migration_candidate_defaults reconstruct the omitted repeated flags. Conforming size fields are summarized per file by count, range and exact-value histogram; their individual JSON Pointers are intentionally omitted. Source path, SHA-256, classification and all existing source-level counts remain. Candidate values are review bounds, never automatic rounding instructions. Fixtures remain unchanged regression inputs.

unavailable.reason: Directory absent in current workspace; Premium models not audited.

verification.note: These are snapshot checks; hashes intentionally expose later source changes. No source files were rewritten.

compact_representation.note: The original full audit verified 7479 explicit fields; compact storage preserves 1125 exceptions in full and summarizes 6354 conforming fields.
